# Polymind (Gyanmarg)

> Polymind (Gyanmarg — Sanskrit for "Path of Knowledge") is a gamified learning platform that transforms 45+ curated ebooks into interactive experiences using spaced repetition, active recall, and interleaving. One system to make the world's most powerful ideas unforgettable.

## Key facts
- Type: Gamified edtech learning platform (web app / PWA)
- Audience: lifelong learners who want to retain books and ideas
- Live: https://ai-polymind.web.app
- Learning science: spaced repetition (SM-2), active recall, interleaving
- Gamification: XP & levels, achievements, daily challenges, streaks
- Content: 45+ ebooks, 76 modules (37 fully available) across 14 categories
- Platform: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite, installable PWA
- Status: Live

## Primary routes
- Home: https://ai-polymind.web.app/
- The Science: https://ai-polymind.web.app/science
- Books: https://ai-polymind.web.app/books
- Blog: https://ai-polymind.web.app/blog

- Privacy: https://ai-polymind.web.app/privacy
- Terms: https://ai-polymind.web.app/terms

## The problem & solution
- The problem: most people forget 90% of what they read within a week.
- The solution: gamified microlearning with scientifically-proven retention techniques.
- The result: knowledge that sticks, skills that compound.

## Features

### Evidence-based learning
- Spaced repetition: SM-2 algorithm flashcards that optimize your review schedule.
- Active recall: quizzes and challenges that force retrieval from memory.
- Interleaving: mixed practice across topics for deeper understanding.

### Gamification
- XP & levels: earn experience points and level up as you learn (500 XP per level).
- Achievements: unlock badges for milestones and streaks.
- Daily challenges: keep your streak alive with daily learning goals.
- Streak tracking with 1 freeze per week.

| Module | Description | Source material |
|--------|-------------|-----------------|
| Personal Development | Master your mindset | Atomic Habits, Deep Work, etc. |
| AI & Machine Learning | Understand the future | Advanced AI concepts |
| Wealth Building | Billionaire strategies | Dalio, Buffett, Munger |
| Bruce Lee Philosophy | Way of the warrior | Tao of Jeet Kune Do |
| Blockchain & Web3 | Decentralized tech | Crypto & DeFi |
| Psychology & Decisions | Dark psychology | Body language, influence |
| Python & Data Science | Code your insights | Programming mastery |
| Mind Mastery | Learning how to learn | Meta-learning |
| Temple Science | Ancient wisdom | Vedic knowledge |
| Master Synthesis | Connect all knowledge | Integration |

## Content catalog
76 modules (37 fully available with complete pathway content; the rest show as "Coming Soon") across 14 categories: Mind & Performance, Technology & Code, Wealth & Power, Finance & Markets, Spirit & Body, Synthesis & Mastery, Science & Universe, Creative Arts, Strategy & Systems, History & Culture, Practical Mastery, Relationships & Society, Ancient Wisdom, Bharat Wisdom.

Each module is structured as levels and lessons (intro, concept, exercise, quiz, reflection, challenge), each with an overview, markdown main content, key takeaway, action item, and quiz.

## Technology
React 19, TypeScript (strict), Vite 7.2, TailwindCSS 3.4, Zustand 4.5, Framer Motion, React Router DOM 7.1, Firebase (Firestore + Auth), PWA (service worker, installable). Deployed via Firebase Hosting + S3/CloudFront.

## Contact
- Product site: https://ai-polymind.web.app
- The app routes (dashboard, pathway, lab, review, profile, challenges, settings, saved) require onboarding and render an authenticated experience.
